Method of Attack: Heap overflow during terminfo database file processing
Denial-of-service vulnerability related to canceled strings
Discoverer: Microsoft Threat Intelligence researchers Jonathan Bar Or, Emanuele Cozzi, and Michael Pearse
Impacted Systems: POSIX-compliant operating systems such as Linux and macOS
Attack Vector: Exploiting vulnerabilities in the ncurses library
Indicators of Compromise: Changes to environment variables like TERMINFO
Privilege escalation and unauthorized code execution
